svg.title: Consume authorization and issuance: all 12 source substeps landed, 0 in progress, 0 open.
svg.desc: A01 authorizer enrollment, A02 post-plan caller control and A03 encrypted-original format are committed in f6dd3cba33fc64670fa78c5dc1bd225b3bb54ef8. A04 durable ciphertext storage, A05 verified retained export, A06 root-controlled key and storage delivery, A07 cold planner connection and A08 private export service are committed in 0ef6024f5d0cf56e865fa39ee767ac57739055e0. A09 independent receiving-purpose custody and A10 independent original-proof replay are committed in b3c9a58472b788b8f06e3824cd57b6f345ecf6c2. A11 actual consume-grant issuance and verification and all five detail steps are source-landed in 4b421e2d26777b904ebe807fcd9dce367a8826f6: wire/signature contract, caller/root admission and derived claims, producer, independent verifier, source integration and consumer join. A12 cold consume-grant service, isolated signer and root-controlled key/FD delivery are source-landed in 8ac2374000de874efb1ededa1a65037d5460b18d. All twelve substeps are landed, none are in progress and none are open. Each numbered segment has a visible name and written status. These twelve substeps and the five-part A11 detail are nested inside landed token-release row 11, not new project milestones. Token release is 11/16 landed, 1 in progress and 4 other open. Reservation/pending row 12 is IN PROGRESS: foundations are committed in 4d4091c72543477823ff4031bfac60e03d79b925, but cold reserver OS/startup and the actual cold SQL pending consumer remain unfinished. That commit is partial evidence, not whole-unit closure. Activation remains 19/26 and project 34/46 source-landed. Counts are nonadditive, not effort percentages. Source is unbuilt and unexecuted; source completion is not test or runtime credit. Production acceptance remains 0/6 verified.
